# Amplify Marketing

> Amplify Marketing Management is a social media and video marketing agency in Dubai, United Arab Emirates (Dubai trade licence 1553366, Department of Economy and Tourism). We film, script, edit and publish short-form video and social media content for UAE businesses and creators on monthly retainers, and we build AI platforms, websites and SEO/AEO for clients with full handover. Founded by Yegor Konyakhin in 2025.

## What we do

- Social media management: content calendars, captions, uploading and scheduling, community management, monthly analytics reporting
- Video production: concepts, scriptwriting, shoot days with our own team, editing and captions built for sound-off viewing
- Content for businesses: barbershops, car clubs, podcasts, car rental, clothing brands, nightlife venues, esports teams, karaoke lounges, real estate, product and tech promo films
- Content for creators and influencers: reels, growth systems, cinematic films, montages, behind-the-scenes, fitness content
- AI platforms: custom AI agents and automations, AI platform development and integration
- Websites, company email setup, SEO and AEO (answer engine optimisation)

## Pricing (AED, per month, cancel anytime)

- Starter, AED 5,000: 6 videos filmed a month, filmed by our team, scripts for every video, professional editing, end-of-month analytics report
- Growth, AED 8,000 (most popular): 3 videos every week, filmed, scripted and edited, access to AI-generated content, uploading and scheduling handled, monthly strategy call, end-of-month analytics report
- Scale, AED 17,000: 6 videos every week, everything in Starter and Growth, in-depth social media analysis, niche and competitor analysis, full strategy for your business
- AI Platforms: custom, quoted per project

## Area served

Dubai and the United Arab Emirates.
